pictures.author: Alex 'Florstein' Fedorov
pictures.observed: Pale blue-green river facade, engaged giant-order round columns, rusticated ground rectangles/arched transoms, upper triangular window pediments, statue/bust niches, strong cornices and rounded green-roof canal corner. Covered gallery/road bridge remain independent.

pictures.author: Yair Haklai
pictures.observed: Closer river/canal corner: pale rustication/transom belt, engaged columns/capitals, end-window pediments, simple standing statue and upper bust niches, curved upper corner/green roof. Fine statuary/inscriptions not copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Hermitage Theatre exterior: exact named native main block and small rear-east courtyard; pale blue-green three-tier Neoclassical river front with ten engaged round giant-order columns/abstract capitals, rusticated ground storey/arched transoms, triangular upper-window pediments, simple statue niches/bust medallions, projecting cornices and low green faceted metal roof with rounded upper canal-side corner. Only the main theatre record is replaced. Preserve the independently identified large rear block, Old Hermitage covered gallery, lower road bridge, quays/roads/Neva/canal and neighboring buildings. Original coarse statuary silhouettes only; no copied sculpture/inscriptions or furnished auditorium/historic Peter I rooms.
